key_metric: Take rate / usage yield -- whether Gross Booking Volume growth is still converting into revenue. Usage yield fell from ~7.03% (FY26) to 6.52% in Q1 FY27 as GBV (+50%) outran usage revenue (+41%); the Street's sourced Q2 pair of $2.86B GBV / $220.5M revenue implies a snap-back to 7.71%, which the trend does not support. Secondary: non-GAAP operating income vs the guided $13.5-14.5M, which embeds a 500bp sequential margin step-down from 11% to 6%.

Take-rate series carries ~+/-0.15pp rounding error because GBV is disclosed to one decimal in billions; the direction survives, the magnitude does not
